richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Dehradun

c: Dehradun, the capital of Uttarakhand, sits in the Doon valley between the Shivalik hills and the Himalayan foothills. It is known for its boarding schools and for national institutions such as the Forest Research Institute and the Indian Military Academy. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Dehradun to schools, colleges, government campuses, residential societies and municipal parks.

Dehradun's weather is hard on outdoor equipment in two different ways. The monsoon is one of the heaviest in north India, and winter mornings are cold and damp. Many sites in the valley also slope, so the ground has to be levelled or terraced before machines go in. We build with galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts and grout the posts into concrete on sloping or soft ground. The machines are made at our Vasai factory, about 1,320 km away, and sent by road.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment go on a sloping site in Dehradun?
items.a: Yes, once the area is levelled or terraced. We grout each post into concrete and suggest a drain on the upper side so water does not run under the machines.

items.q: How do the machines cope with the heavy monsoon?
items.a: Galvanised frames and plastic seats do not rust or rot in rain. Keep drains clear, wipe the seats before use, and check footings after the monsoon.

items.q: Do you supply schools in Uttarakhand?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai, and our team or a dealer covering north India installs the machines. Send the site details to sales@funplaysystems.com.
